attributes.title: UCSF Neuro and Musculoskeletal Imaging 2027 (RAD27022)
attributes.organizer: UCSF Office of Continuing Medical Education
attributes.summary:
UCSF's Neuro and Musculoskeletal Imaging course (RAD27022) runs from Sunday, February 7, to Friday, February 12, 2027, at the Fairmont Orchid in Kamuela, Hawaii. Neuroradiology lectures cover adult and pediatric emergencies, head and neck masses, headache, cranial nerves, neonatal brain injury, spinal anomalies and infections; the musculoskeletal part reviews the major joints, injuries, infection, muscle imaging and arthritis.

The course carries up to 25 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. Physicians and other health professionals pay $1,495 before December 12, 2026, and $1,595 after; onsite registration is $1,645. Online registration closes February 5, 2027, at 5 p.m. Pacific.
